title: Tenma Tsukasa — A Persistent Game Of Tag〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we returned to the jungle cave to get our living space set up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But... It's not as big as we initially expected. This may be just barely enough space to serve as our sleeping area.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no wind or rain to speak of right now, so why don't we set up the living space next to our base camp instead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds good, so let's return to where Nene and the others are. We should also keep an eye out for any flotsam that we can use as blankets and covers along the way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed! The cruiser also has some, but there's no harm in having more!
Coast

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... What can we use as blankets or covers...? Aha...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is this a sail from a yacht...?
It's torn, but we should still be able to use it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
I found something that's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's odd...
He was here just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui? Hello?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's he doing with his face stuck in the bushes?

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, there you are.
What are you doing snooping around in the bushes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Tsukasa, perfect.
I was just about to come get you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here, take a peek. Try looking at the foot of that tree.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The foot of that tree?

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey C
rows.Line: Ook... Ook?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm seeing three baby monkeys...
What about them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just keep watching.
Those monkeys all seem to have a very different personality from one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, the one swinging around that branch seems fairly assertive. That other one is happily going along with its antics while the third is timidly hunched over.

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook!

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook♪

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey C
rows.Line: O-Ook... Ook...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm starting to see their individual personalities...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Interesting. And then, you can...

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hey, you guys, guess what?!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <The big folk that walked into our territory earlier... They're called “humans”!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Yes, grandfather's told me stories about them!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey C
rows.Line: Ook... Ook?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Those monkeys looked so strange. Which forest do you think they came from?>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Not a forest!
They came from beyond the salty water!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Something along those lines?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You caught me off guard when you suddenly started doing voices for them, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Believing that humans are monkeys who came from another forest and the way they described seawater... It was very interesting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wasn't it? It was a fun way to get in some acting practice, but it was also a nice way to work on getting in character by learning how others think and see the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, if you were in those monkeys' shoes, how would you describe the cruiser we arrived here on?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well... A big box...? No...
The concept of a box may be foreign to them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Metal? White? Triangle? No...
Those concepts may also be beyond their grasp.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... This is harder than I thought.
How would you describe our cruiser, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, they might see it as a large fish with a tough exterior or a strangely hard stone that can somehow float on the water...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. A giant fish seems plausible.
But I'm less sure about it being a rock.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was predicated on those monkeys being able to discern that our cruiser isn't a living creature.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And like you said, Tsukasa, “metal” may be a foreign concept to them. That's why I thought it'd be better to call it something other than “metal”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's identifiable by how hard it is, so I simply guessed that they'd end up calling it some sort of rock or stone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's cool to the touch as well, so they may even expand upon that by calling it a type of cool stone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, now I understand! That explains your stone idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, is there more to that conversation you just voiced?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More? Not exactly, but I did come up with some ideas as to how their conversation would've continued.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They'll feel compelled to go down by the water, see that we're trying to fix our vessel and set sail by stealing it somehow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And they'll go on a big adventure! That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Unfortunately, we'd be stranded here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And we've been chatting up a storm.
We should probably start working on getting our living space set up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Right... That does take priority...
Still, why don't we keep talking while we work?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see it now! A fantastic adventure about humans getting lost in a forest full of monkeys where they learn to work together despite not being able to communicate through speech!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound fantastic.
Let's discuss that further!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, first, the part about not being able to communicate seems like the most interesting part, since there could be instances where some wires get crossed...!
